findings.quote: YNAB Alternatives 2026: Prices and Plans Compared
findings.problem: SEO title is 49 characters; rule 5 requires 50 to 60.
findings.fix: Lengthen, e.g. 'YNAB Alternatives 2026: Prices and Plans Compared Side by Side' only if <=60, or 'YNAB Alternatives 2026: Plans, Prices and Features Compared'.

findings.quote: $3.99 per month billed annually ($47.88 per year; regular list price $6.99 per month, or $83.88 per year)
findings.problem: $47.88 and $83.88 are derived (Quicken footnote: final price may differ from monthly x 12); $3.99 is a first-year, new-member offer expiring Dec 8, 2026 but is called 'the published rate', used as the cheapest paid option in verdict/FAQ and in arithmetic ($61.12 lower).
findings.fix: Lead with regular $6.99/month billed annually, label $3.99 as a limited first-year new-member offer, drop $47.88 and the '$61.12 lower' comparison or mark as estimate.

findings.quote: Figures reflect regular list prices in US dollars before local sales taxes. / Copilot Money ... $9 per month billed yearly at $109 (regularly $119). Monthly price not published.
findings.problem: Table note says regular list prices but includes promotional prices; Copilot 'monthly price not published' unverified (page has Yearly/Monthly toggle).
findings.fix: Fix note wording; remove 'monthly price not published/not displayed' claims everywhere (table, choose section, Copilot section, 'What Would Change' bullet).

findings.quote: Does the software support ... / Does the platform offer a one-time purchase ... / The service recommends signing up on the web / The software connects to ... / The company publishes
findings.problem: Coy abstractions on a page naming its subjects.
findings.fix: Name the products ('Does the app you pick ...' -> 'Does YNAB or the alternative ...').

findings.quote: At The Modern Wallet, we lay out the arithmetic behind subscription costs
findings.problem: Self-referential 'we' tee-up in the intro; weak.
findings.fix: Delete or replace with a concrete fact.

findings.quote: YNAB remains the better option for households committed to assigning every dollar a job
findings.problem: Reads as a recommendation; page rules say list, never recommend ('fits households that...').

findings.quote: Monarch Money ... The service recommends signing up on the web and provides a 7-day trial.
findings.problem: Monarch's page says 'Your first week is on us', not '7-day trial'; stated as published fact.
findings.fix: Quote 'first week free' or say 'first week free (7 days)'.

findings.quote: What Would Change Our Answer on YNAB Alternatives
findings.problem: Heading plus 'Who This Is Not For' fine, but 'Who This Is Not For' text points to a hub for small business tools rather than stating a limit; sentence 'Those looking for ... can review dedicated alternatives platforms in our financial comparisons hub' is vague.
findings.fix: Link a specific page (/compare/) or state the limit directly.

findings.problem: Evidence tag not in required format.
